title: Ballon d’Or 2026 Winners: Full List
subtitle: SI
paragraphs: By Grey Whitebloom12:27 PM EDTThe Ballon d’Or offers the winner more than just a shiny golden orb. / Jose Breton/Pics Action/NurPhoto/Getty Images• PLEASE CLICK/TAP HERE TO REFRESH FOR LIVE UPDATES TO THIS ARTICLEAs Kylian Mbappé once gushed, capturing the modern obsession with this individual award, the Ballon d’Or is “the Holy Grail,” the “ticket to the big world.”

Real Madrid’s prolific striker is front and center on a night which will see not one, not two, but 13 different prizes dished out at The London Palladium. The standout men and women, youngsters, goalkeepers, coaches and clubs will all be ruthlessly ranked and categorized by a panel of journalists.

“We all watched that ceremony with those red carpet arrivals and said to ourselves: One day, that will be me,” Mbappé has admitted. Now, he—and the rest of the great and the good of the sport—are on that red carpet. But only a select few will end the night clutching that golden ticket.

Harry Kane outstripped everyone with a staggering haul of 73 for Bayern Munich and England while Poland’s Ewa Pajor followed up her 2025 prize with another prolific year at Barcelona.

This unique prize ignores all action on the pitch to instead honor the individual (or collective) to “identify the best solidarity actions carried out by committed champions.” Named after the legendary Brazilian whose committment to social causes was as legendary as his right foot, the prize has been handed out since 2022.
